ai.description: *Hemorrhois ravergieri* reaches 120 cm. It features a grey or beige body with dark, often interconnected dorsal blotches and a distinct dark stripe from the eye to the mouth.
ai.identificationRemarks: *Hemorrhois ravergieri* is best distinguished by its distinct "dorsal blotches" that often fuse into a zigzag pattern, combined with a dark, tear-drop mark below the eye.
ai.habitat: The Spotted Whip Snake inhabits arid, rocky slopes and scrublands, often found in dry mountainous regions at altitudes ranging from 500 to 2,500 meters.
ai.behavior: The Spotted Whip Snake is primarily diurnal and actively hunts lizards and small rodents, often using its keen eyesight to pursue prey across rocky terrain.
ai.reproductionNotes: *Hemorrhois ravergieri* is oviparous, typically laying a clutch of 5–15 eggs during the summer months (May to July) in India.
ai.distributionRemarks: In the Indian subcontinent, *Hemorrhois ravergieri* is found in the arid regions of Ladakh and Jammu & Kashmir, typically occurring at elevations between 2,000 and 4,000m.
